data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 165,799k (2016 - GBP 121,917k) is a deterioration of GBP 11,547k (2016 - deterioration of GBP 6,859k) to the claims reserves established at the prior year end, principally due to natural catastrophes (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico Earthquake and Californian Wildfires) and adverse attritional development in prior year reserves on the Property and Marine classes.

named_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the Mexico earthquakes
named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate's reinsurance programme ... significantly ameliorated the impact with net losses totalling $22,359k (GBP 16,546k). These losses triggered reinstatements premium with the acceleration of the earning of the catastrophe excess of loss protection further impacting the results.
The Californian Wildfires further deteriorated the Property account with net losses of $8,248k (GBP 6,104k) incurred at the year end.

named_events.event_name: Ogden discount rate (release of 2016 Ogden margin)
named_events.loss_description: Losses were partially offset by an improvement on the Liability class driven by the release of the 2016 Ogden margin as well as favourable claims development in the year.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 gross claims outstanding were GBP 353.514m. During 2017 the Syndicate recognised adverse prior year development, a deterioration of GBP 11.547m (net), driven principally by a combination of major natural catastrophe events in 2017 (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, the Mexico earthquakes and Californian wildfires) and adverse attritional/large loss development on the Property and Marine accounts. The net deterioration corresponds to a c.3.3% increase versus opening gross claims outstanding. Liability experienced some favourable development (including a release related to the Ogden margin) partially offsetting losses.

data.data_quality_notes: The report does not provide an explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure in the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note; the note explicitly states a NET deterioration of GBP 11,547k which has been used (flagged as net). A gross prior-year movement can be approximated from the gross claims development triangle (approx +20.956m gross strengthening by triangle diagonal method), but that was not used as the primary source because the report's movement note gives an explicit net figure. Prior-year movement therefore reported here is NET of reinsurance - no explicit gross PYD was provided in a single gross movement line.
